# pdfdiff

Compare two PDF files from the command line or Node. Raster overlay plus extracted-text changes. Node >= 22.13.

## CLI

Not on npm yet. From a clone: `pnpm install && pnpm run build:packages`, then
`pnpm exec pdfdiff`. Once published: `npx @pdfdiff/cli`. Packages ship as 0.1.0;
repo tag v1.0.0 is the app/site release.

```
pnpm exec pdfdiff <earlier.pdf> <newer.pdf>
pnpm exec pdfdiff earlier.pdf newer.pdf --report json --fail-on-change
pnpm exec pdfdiff earlier.pdf newer.pdf --images ./diff-out
pnpm exec pdfdiff earlier.pdf newer.pdf --text-only --report markdown
```

`--report` is `text` (default), `json`, `csv`, or `markdown`. `--images <dir>` writes overlay PNGs named `a{earlier}-b{newer}.png` for changed, added, and removed pages. `--text-only` skips pixel comparison. `--fail-on-change` exits 1 when anything changed. `--fail-on-unreadable` exits 1 when fonts have no Unicode map. `--quiet` suppresses progress and warnings; the report still prints.

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 fail-on-* tripped, 2 usage, 3 runtime.

JSON schema: `pdfdiff/report.schema.json`. Warnings go to stderr; the report goes to stdout (or `--out`).

## Node

```ts
import { comparePdfs } from "@pdfdiff/cli";
const { report } = await comparePdfs("earlier.pdf", "newer.pdf");
```

Pass `{ visual: false }` for text only, or `onOverlay` to receive RGBA overlays.

## Do not

- Treat a clean result as trustworthy when `totals.pagesWithUnreadableText > 0` — drawings can still change visually, but wording cannot be read.
- Expect pixel-identical output to https://pdfdiff.app. Node uses Skia, the site uses the browser canvas.
- Diff scanned PDFs for text; use the visual path (the default) for drawings and scans.
